Vanessa — thanks for flagging. Proposed approach:

Thanks — quick security checklist (minimum):
- SOC2 Type II report snapshot (last 12 months) + control gap summary
- Architecture diagram showing private VPC peering, CIDR ranges, and egress block rules
- KMS/HSM integration approach (key rotation and customer-managed keys)
- Pen test executive summary (last 12 months) or attestation of scanning cadence
- Data classification & retention plan for pilot datasets

Notes and caveats:
- If Lumen requires on-prem air-gapped nodes, this triggers additional procurement timelines and higher cost — clarify in LOA.
- For initial approval we can accept a SOC2 snapshot + signed attestation pending full report delivery within 30 days.

I recommend we mark the credits as conditional until evidence is provided. Happy to review documents before they go to procurement.

— Karthik
Head of Product Security, Redwood Inference

Attached is a draft onboarding checklist and pilot success criteria (see POC-Framework-Checklist.xlsx). Key onboarding steps:
- Sign LOA with pilot dates and acceptance criteria (DocuSign)
- Security intake: receive SOC2 snapshot + KMS diagram + egress policy
- Provisioning: reserve dedicated nodes, apply network ACLs, enable per-route tracing in Console
- Validation: run 3 sample workloads, measure 95th pct latency and token-cost per scenario
- Wrap: joint review and decision point at day 60 (metrics pass => move to paid Dedicated or cancel)

I also recommend a small onboarding credit for setup hours (up to 8 engineer hours). If procurement wants that included in the LOA we should call it out as a separate small credit line.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
